I replied to Gideon in the thread on #strategic-pod. The corrected Vantorre Group seat count he posted on 1 Jul is **280**.

He first posted 300 at 09:14, then corrected it to 280 at 09:19. The 300 included sandbox logins from their May rollout. The 280 was the active production roster as of 1 Jul.

I also told him this is a 1 Jul snapshot, so he should check the CRM if the deck needs today's count.
